title: Robustness Evaluation of GPU Cloud Pricing Benchmarks under Incomplete Observations: A Controlled Missingness Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.17796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Daily GPU rental-price benchmarks can fail when marketplace quotes are missing. This article stress-tests a fixed equal-weight median rule under four imposed masking mechanisms and four benchmark-level recovery methods. Across 5,800 Monte Carlo realisations in 27 scenarios on 190 held-out days, whole-source outages reduce publication coverage to 0.77 while preserving zero conditional error on published dates; composition-changing loss retains 0.86 coverage but produces 7.74 log points of error. A separate past-only stratum-level ablation reduces error by 4.15 to 6.70 log points in five composition-changing cases, using a richer information set. An observable-signal withholding rule improves the primary error-coverage criterion in 0 of 10 cases. Results concern observed asking-price measurements, not transaction prices or identified real-world missingness mechanisms.

translated_title: 不完整观测下GPU云定价基准的鲁棒性评估：一项受控缺失研究
translated_abstract: 当市场报价缺失时，每日GPU租赁价格基准可能会失效。本文在四种人为设置的掩蔽机制和四种基准级恢复方法下，对固定的等权中位数规则进行了压力测试。在190个保留测试日、27种场景共5,800次蒙特卡洛模拟中，全源中断使发布覆盖率降至0.77，同时在发布日期上保持零条件误差；而成分变化型损失保持0.86的覆盖率，但产生7.74个对数点的误差。一项单独的仅使用历史数据的层级消融实验，在五个成分变化案例中利用更丰富的信息集将误差降低了4.15至6.70个对数点。一种可观测信号保留规则在10个案例中对主要误差-覆盖率指标的改善次数为零。研究结果仅针对观察到的报价测量，而非成交价格或已识别的真实世界缺失机制。
tldr: 本文通过受控缺失实验对GPU云租赁价格基准进行压力测试，发现全源中断主要损害覆盖率而成分变化损失引入显著误差，且仅用历史数据的层级消融方法能有效将误差降低4.15至6.70个对数点。
en_tdlr: This controlled missingness study stress-tests GPU cloud pricing benchmarks, showing that whole-source outages mainly reduce coverage while composition-changing losses introduce substantial error, and that a past-only stratum-level ablation reduces error by 4.15–6.70 log points.
